fields.title: JoseKiarie Pharmacy Management System
fields.tagline: Full-stack inventory, POS, and staff-management system for a Nairobi pharmacy — Django DRF backend with Flutter mobile client.
fields.short_description: Pharmacy management portal with JWT RBAC, batch/FIFO stock tracking, POS, supplier management, and a Flutter mobile client.
fields.problem_statement: The pharmacy was managing stock levels, supplier invoices, batch expiry dates, and daily sales entirely on paper and disconnected Excel workbooks. No audit trail for stock movements, no early warning for expiring batches, no real-time sales visibility for management. Staff had unrestricted access, creating accountability gaps and accidental overwrites.
fields.solution:
Multi-component management system:

Backend: Django DRF REST API handling inventory, batch tracking, sales, supplier orders, staff authentication, and reporting.

Auth & Permissions: JWT with two role tiers — Administrator and Pharmacist. Admins manage staff and adjust stock; pharmacists process sales only.

Inventory & Batch System: Products tracked at batch level with expiry dates. Sales deduct from earliest batch (FIFO) to reduce waste.

Flutter POS Client: Product search, cart management, quantity input, receipt generation, authenticated against the Django backend.

Dashboard: Low-stock alerts, batches expiring within 30 days, daily sales totals.
fields.my_role: Sole engineer. Requirements gathering, PostgreSQL schema, Django models, DRF serialisers, JWT authentication, Flutter app architecture, API integration, Postman documentation, Linux VPS deployment.
fields.architecture_notes:
Stack: Django 5, DRF, PostgreSQL via Supabase, Flutter, Nginx + Gunicorn.
Key tables: Product, Batch, StockMovement, Sale, SaleItem, Supplier, PurchaseOrder, CustomUser.
FIFO batch deduction: queryset ordered expiry_date ASC iterated inside atomic transaction with SELECT FOR UPDATE.
Auth: SimpleJWT — 15-min access tokens, 7-day refresh tokens. Custom IsAdministrator / IsPharmacist permission classes.
fields.challenges:
Concurrent stock deduction: Solved with database-level row locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE) in atomic transactions.
Batch FIFO accuracy: Daily background task marks batches where expiry_date < today as exhausted.
Flutter JWT refresh: Transparent token refresh via Dio interceptor with retry logic on 401 responses.
fields.outcomes: Backend fully operational with all API endpoints tested and documented via Postman. Flutter POS client functional on Android. Core inventory, batch tracking, and sales recording working in staging. Pending final client review before production deployment.

fields.title: AgriFlow — Farm-to-Buyer Marketplace
fields.tagline: Flutter mobile marketplace connecting Kenyan smallholder farmers to local buyers with M-Pesa STK Push payment integration.
fields.short_description: Mobile-first agri-commerce platform with farmer dashboards, product listing, order management, and M-Pesa Daraja integration.
fields.problem_statement: Smallholder farmers sell produce at below-market prices because they have no direct channel to buyers beyond their immediate locality. No accessible, mobile-first platform let a farmer list produce and receive direct M-Pesa payment from a buyer.
fields.solution:
Two-sided marketplace with separate dashboards for Farmers and Buyers.

Farmer: Register farm, list produce with category, quantity, price, and photo. View and manage orders.

Buyer: Browse by category, search by location, add to cart, checkout via M-Pesa STK Push.

Backend: Django DRF handling user registration, product CRUD, order lifecycle, and M-Pesa Daraja callbacks.
fields.my_role: Sole engineer. Requirements, PostgreSQL schema, Django DRF API, M-Pesa Daraja integration, Flutter app architecture, farmer and buyer UI screens, API integration layer.
fields.architecture_notes:
Stack: Django DRF, PostgreSQL, Flutter.
Key models: Farm, Product, ProductCategory, Order, OrderItem, MpesaTransaction, CustomUser (user_type: farmer/buyer).
M-Pesa flow: POST /api/payments/initiate/ → Daraja STK Push → Safaricom callback → update Order.status = paid.
fields.challenges:
M-Pesa callback: Required publicly accessible endpoint; used ngrok for local testing.
Two-role Flutter navigation: Conditional routing based on JWT payload user_type field.
fields.outcomes: Complete MVP: product listing, order flow, and M-Pesa STK Push in Safaricom sandbox. Flutter app running on Android. Pending production Daraja credentials.

fields.name: Joseph Ngigi Kiarie
fields.headline: Full-Stack Developer & Systems Architect
fields.short_bio: I build dependable Django web backends, Flutter mobile applications, and PostgreSQL/Supabase database architectures for real Kenyan organisations — replacing paper records and spreadsheet chaos with systems that actually work in the field.
fields.long_bio:
I am a BBIT student at Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology (JKUAT) and a practicing full-stack software engineer based in Nairobi, Kenya.

My academic training gives me a double lens: I understand business operations, supply chains, and accounting workflows just as deeply as database normalisation, query execution plans, and REST API design.

In local Kenyan organisations, software failures rarely happen because the UI was not shiny enough. They happen because inventory math did not account for concurrent orders, staff roles were not properly restricted, or offline mobile sync silently corrupted data. I engineer systems from the database outward.
fields.availability_status: Available for new client projects & technical consulting
fields.response_time_statement: I typically respond within 24 business hours.

fields.description: Designing, building, and deploying end-to-end software systems for Kenyan businesses. Specialising in inventory management portals, Flutter mobile applications, and REST API backends with M-Pesa payment integration.
